sources.notes: Original 500 Polish surname spellings preserved from Poland incidence estimates; Kruk correction independently documented in original batch.

First 1,000 male-form surnames from Polish Ministry of Digital Affairs PESEL register of living people as of 20 January 2026; official Polish diacritics preserved. Mirror is a 2,000-row selected snapshot, not full register. The official dataset is available as CC0 data.

Additional surnames selected from Poland-tagged aggregate Facebook-account rankings, cleaned and deduplicated against PESEL and original pool; not representative of Polish residents or source-certified to the individual person. Upstream source is a 2021 leaked Facebook account dataset. Nonproduction exploratory source; original rank-derived weights discarded and licenses/attestation require final audit.
